top_signals.title: Iraq Boosts Oil Exports to 3.6 Million Barrels per Day
top_signals.summary: Iraq has raised its oil exports to 3.6 million barrels per day (bpd), its oil minister said as OPEC’s second-largest producer seeks a much higher production capacity and quota baselines from the cartel. Iraq’s oil exports increased to 3.6 million bpd, Oil Minister Basim Mohammed Khudair Al-Abadi told the Iraqi News Agency (INA) in an interview this week.
